svg.desc: Seven hachured bars, log-scaled, running from a one-nanosecond L1 cache hit to a ten-millisecond disk seek, each labelled with its real latency and with a human-scale equivalent on the right showing that if an L1 hit took one second, a disk seek would take four months.
